title: Controllability for semi-discrete semilinear stochastic parabolic operators
summary: In \cite{LPP:2025}, it was shown that, in arbitrary dimension, the spatial semi-discretization of a controlled stochastic parabolic operator is generically not null-controllable. Nevertheless, $φ$-null controllability results remain attainable. The present paper extends those results to semi-discrete semilinear stochastic operators in arbitrary dimension, whose nonlinearities may also depend on the first-order spatial derivatives.
